key_decisions: Zero-duration backstops added to onWaveformScrubStart AND onWaveformKeydown (in addition to D-G's isParamLocked guard): D-G's verbatim snippet showed only the lock guard, but pinned WF-I2.10 requires a total no-op at zero duration — clampOffset(x, 0) returns 0, so without the backstop a draft-of-0 / offset write would still land. Scenario pin beats verbatim snippet; world-review sanctioned (H1).

formatTime exposed as a template method via the inline wiring script (methodsConfig: { ...createMetronomadMethods(), formatTime }): the pinned :aria-valuetext="'Offset ' + formatTime(offset)" cannot reference a module-scope import from a Vue template (whitelisted globals only; failure would be _ctx.formatTime is not a function at render). The methods factory stays pure; the template dependency is wired at the template's wiring point (new learning doc).

Tab order re-pinned from actual DOM order, not the plan's 'takes the scrubber's slot' prose: tab order = DOM order and the canvas lives in the progress block BELOW the playback buttons, so the canonical 8-element sequence ENDS with waveformCanvas. keyboard.spec.cjs carries a comment naming the invariant; moving the progress region to match the prose would be an unapproved layout change (world-review discussion item, not a defect).

E2E-3.10 asserts #app input[type=range] count 0 (the scrubber was the app's only range input) rather than a literal #offsetScrubber locator — keeps the O-1 grep pass (zero string hits in index.html test/ MyComponents/ MyESModules/) literally satisfiable while still proving DOM removal; all comment references to the old id were stripped for the same reason.

E2E-3.6 logger discipline: wait for the COMMITTED readout (toHaveText) AND for the in-page 5 ms logger to have RECORDED the terminal tick (waitForFunction on the log tail) before draining — the DOM leads the logger by up to one tick; intermediate ticks asserted as a range (monotonic, ≥3 samples, start ≥0.6 and <1.8) because load coalescing can merge two pointer events into one 5 ms window (two separate flake modes, one per run — new learning doc).

E2E-3.7 drives pointercancel/blur with synthetic in-page PointerEvents: the synthetic pointerdown's setPointerCapture(1) throws NotFoundError (no active pointer), absorbed by the production W-1 try/catch, so the real cancel/cleanup state machine runs; a follow-up TRUSTED page.mouse.click doubles as the no-stuck-state canary. Draft-live/discard assertions target the READOUT (displayPosition), not #offsetInput — the field mirrors the committed offset only (WF-I2.3/2.4 pin).
No commit made: the working tree carries uncommitted Phase 1–4 CR 001 work (user-managed); mixing Phase 5 into it would require hunk-level splitting across shared files. Flagged for the user instead.
